scripts.prod: npm run build -w @smartopd/web && concurrently -n server,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run start -w @smartopd/server" "npm run start -w @smartopd/web"
scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @smartopd/server" "npm run dev -w @smartopd/web"
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @smartopd/shared && npm run typecheck -w @smartopd/server && npm run typecheck -w @smartopd/web
